notes: No loops. All Vat calls, the two storage-field writes and the Exec event are correct; the write order of last/lastInc is merged (different fields of one slot, no reads between - same final state). The extcodesize checks before both file calls are dropped after STATICCALLs to the same address (sound, as in c00267). add(ilkLastInc, ilkTtl)'s overflow require is gone (sum of two uint48 cannot overflow). remIlk clears the 144 low bits of the third slot (three uint48 fields), matching delete. The struct mapping is left as stor0 although ilks(bytes32) returns all its members (no misleading name). Same DSMath helpers as c00267.
summary: Faithful, compact text; minor noise from the short-circuit mul check printed as phis and the lineNew expression recomputed instead of reusing its binding; vat immutable read as 0 (artifact).
